table_format: checks.jsonl.gz is deterministic gzip-compressed JSON Lines; one independent check per line. issues.jsonl and issues.csv contain failures only.
original_value: raw_value is the exact original JSON value at input/json_pointer. Null is JSON null, never empty occupancy.

references.source_rule_ref: reference_catalog.json /rules/{id}: frozen source archive, commit, SHA, source line, original predicate, message and category
references.contract_clause_ref: reference_catalog.json /clauses/{id}: frozen Git document, SHA, line and exact clause
references.capture_source_ref: reference_catalog.json /sources/{id}: capture file path, SHA and bytes
references.feedback_source_ref: reference_catalog.json /sources/{id}: original feedback file path, SHA and bytes

statuses.PASS: Predicate holds on original values; not acceptance or calibrated coverage
statuses.FAIL: Independent predicate fails; actual_execution distinguishes first refusal from masked or downstream-only issues
statuses.NOT_EVALUABLE: A required value/branch prerequisite is absent; not a proven extra violation
statuses.NOT_APPLICABLE: The explicit guard does not apply, e.g. position=null skips the conflict test
statuses.INFORMATIONAL: Original field preserved; no independent rejection or no machine-parsed semantics

coverage: All source guard families, all declared nonnull interval cells, every supplied alternative polygon and every object state/evidence field; no missing fields are filled.
